title: Session event envelope, version 1
description: Every event a runner publishes. Every field is a claim by an untrusted producer: session_id must match the subject and workspace_id must match the session row, or the event is quarantined. Unknown top-level fields are ignored.

event_id.description: Producer-generated, UUIDv7. With session_id and producer, the deduplication key.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the event type's schema. An unknown major is quarantined; a newer minor is accepted and its unknown fields ignored.

type.description: The normalized type stored in history. The transport name is session.<type>.v<major>. An unknown type is quarantined.

occurred_at.description: The producer's claim. Stored, never used for ordering.

session_id.description: The aggregate, and the ordering key.

payload.description: Validated against the schema for type and major version.
